Show less Read more Like 13 Dislike Reply 9 replies Hide replies 9 replies Comments 52 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam In this video Transcript Description Artemis II crew leave Earth's orbit on journey to the moon 152Likes14,340ViewsApr 32026 The crew of Artemis II have exited Earth's orbit and are now heading to the moon. The engines of their Orion capsule were fired up, allowing them to perform the manoeuvre to escape Earth's gravity. The thrust from the rockets would have made a car accelerate from 0-60 mph in 2.7 seconds. The crew are due to reach the moon on Monday for a brief flyby before heading back to Earth.
